requirements.text: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation, except that no marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
requirements.test_case: Check the R10 approval communication and inspect the lamp for the approval mark, or confirm it is approved as part of a unit.

requirements.text: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review EMC test reports (emissions and immunity) for the lamp as an ESA and confirm compliance in normal use.

requirements.text: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.test_case: Perform or review ESA radiated and conducted emission and immunity tests per UN R10 annexes.

requirements.text: The broadband electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband radiated emissions per Annex 7 in the 400-1000 MHz band and verify they are below 63 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limit shall be 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband radiated emissions per Annex 7 in the 75-400 MHz band and compare with the 52-63 dBµV/m limit.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limit shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband radiated emissions per Annex 7 in the 30-75 MHz band and compare with the 62-52 dBµV/m limit.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Check in the EMC test report that all measured broadband values are below the limit line of Appendix 6.

requirements.text: The narrowband electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Measure narrowband radiated emission per Annex 8 from 400 to 1000 MHz and confirm it stays below 53 dB µV/m.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limit shall be 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure narrowband radiated emission per Annex 8 from 75 to 400 MHz and compare with the limit line in Appendix 7.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limit shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure narrowband radiated emission per Annex 8 from 30 to 75 MHz and compare with the limit line in Appendix 7.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured narrowband value, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Review the EMC test report to confirm the narrowband emission values are below the limits across 30-1000 MHz.

requirements.text: For negative pulse amplitude polarity, the ESA emission shall have a maximum allowed pulse amplitude of -100 V for vehicles with 12 V systems and -450 V for vehicles with 24 V systems.
requirements.test_case: Measure negative transient pulses per ISO 7637-2 and check that the amplitude does not go below -100 V (12 V) or -450 V (24 V).

requirements.text: For positive pulse amplitude polarity, the ESA emission shall have a maximum allowed pulse amplitude of +75 V for vehicles with 12 V systems and +150 V for vehicles with 24 V systems.
requirements.test_case: Measure positive transient pulses per ISO 7637-2 and check that the amplitude does not exceed +75 V (12 V) or +150 V (24 V).

requirements.text: The emission of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Run the ISO 7637-2 transient emission test per Annex 10 on a representative lamp and compare the pulses with the Table 1 levels.

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
requirements.test_case: Check the Annex 9 radiated immunity test report for a representative lamp ESA.

requirements.text: The ALSE ESA immunity test for the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be performed at a test level of 25 V/m for the frequency range 80 to 2,000 MHz below 2 GHz, as given in Table 2b.
requirements.test_case: If ALSE used, verify 25 V/m over 80-2000 MHz minimum level.

requirements.text: The ALSE ESA immunity test in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be performed at a test level of 10 V/m for the frequency range 2,000 to 6,000 MHz above 2 GHz, as given in Table 2a.
requirements.test_case: If ALSE used, verify 10 V/m over 2000-6000 MHz.

requirements.text: The ALSE ESA immunity test in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be performed at a test level of 30 V/m for the frequency range 80 to 2,000 MHz below 2 GHz, as given in Table 2a.
requirements.test_case: If ALSE used, verify 30 V/m over 80-2000 MHz.

requirements.text: The BCI ESA immunity test for the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be performed at a test level of 50 mA for the frequency range 20 to 400 MHz below 2 GHz, as given in Table 2b.
requirements.test_case: If BCI used, verify 50 mA over 20-400 MHz minimum level.

requirements.text: The BCI ESA immunity test in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be performed at a test level of 60 mA for the frequency range 20 to 400 MHz below 2 GHz, as given in Table 2a.
requirements.test_case: If BCI used, verify 60 mA over 20-400 MHz.

requirements.text: The ESA immunity test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be as given in Table 2a.
requirements.test_case: Confirm test levels per Table 2a in the immunity test report.

requirements.text: The ESA test severity for the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be as given in Table 2b.
requirements.test_case: Confirm minimum levels per Table 2b in the test report.

requirements.text: The TEM cell ESA immunity test for the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be performed at a test level of 62,5 V/m for the frequency range 20 to 200 MHz below 2 GHz, as given in Table 2b.
requirements.test_case: If TEM cell used, verify 62.5 V/m over 20-200 MHz minimum level.

requirements.text: The TEM cell ESA immunity test in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be performed at a test level of 75 V/m for the frequency range 20 to 200 MHz below 2 GHz, as given in Table 2a.
requirements.test_case: If TEM cell used, verify 75 V/m over 20-200 MHz.

requirements.text: The reverberation chamber ESA immunity test for the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be performed at a test level of 18 V/m for the frequency range LUF to 2,000 MHz below 2 GHz, as given in Table 2b.
requirements.test_case: If reverberation chamber used, verify 18 V/m LUF-2000 MHz minimum level.

requirements.text: The reverberation chamber ESA immunity test in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be performed at a test level of 21 V/m for the frequency range LUF to 2,000 MHz below 2 GHz, as given in Table 2a.
requirements.test_case: If reverberation chamber used, verify 21 V/m LUF-2000 MHz.

requirements.text: The reverberation chamber ESA immunity test in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be performed at a test level of 7 V/m for the frequency range 2,000 to 6,000 MHz above 2 GHz, as given in Table 2a.
requirements.test_case: If reverberation chamber used, verify 7 V/m over 2000-6000 MHz.

requirements.text: The stripline ESA immunity test for the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be performed at a test level of 50 V/m for the frequency range 20 to 400 MHz below 2 GHz, as given in Table 2b.
requirements.test_case: If stripline used, verify 50 V/m over 20-400 MHz minimum level.

requirements.text: The stripline ESA immunity test in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be performed at a test level of 60 V/m for the frequency range 20 to 400 MHz below 2 GHz, as given in Table 2a.
requirements.test_case: If stripline used, verify 60 V/m over 20-400 MHz.

requirements.text: The ALSE ESA immunity test for the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be performed at a test level of 8 V/m for the frequency range 2,000 to 6,000 MHz above 2 GHz, as given in Table 2b.
requirements.test_case: If ALSE used, verify 8 V/m over 2000-6000 MHz minimum level.

requirements.text: The reverberation chamber ESA immunity test for the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be performed at a test level of 6 V/m for the frequency range 2,000 to 6,000 MHz above 2 GHz, as given in Table 2b.
requirements.test_case: If reverberation chamber used, verify 6 V/m over 2000-6000 MHz minimum level.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: During Annex 9 tests, monitor lamp function (light output, no flicker or state change) for no degradation.

requirements.text: For pulse 1, the ESA representative of this type shall be tested at -75 V (12 V system) or -450 V (24 V system) for 500 pulses, with FPSC III for immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity.
requirements.test_case: Apply pulse 1 at -75 V (12 V) or -450 V (24 V) for 500 pulses and verify FPSC III.

requirements.text: For pulse 2a, the ESA representative of this type shall be tested at +37 V in 12 V and 24 V systems for 500 pulses, with FPSC I for immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity.
requirements.test_case: Apply pulse 2a at +37 V for 500 pulses and verify FPSC I for immunity-related functions and FPSC III for others.

requirements.text: For pulse 2b, the ESA representative of this type shall be tested at +10 V (12 V system) or +20 V (24 V system) for 10 pulses, with FPSC II for immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity.
requirements.test_case: Apply pulse 2b at +10 V (12 V) or +20 V (24 V) for 10 pulses and verify FPSC II for immunity-related functions and FPSC III for others.

requirements.text: For pulse 3a, the ESA representative of this type shall be tested at -112 V (12 V system) or -150 V (24 V system) for 1 h, with FPSC I for immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity.
requirements.test_case: Apply pulse 3a at -112 V (12 V) or -150 V (24 V) for 1 h and verify FPSC I for immunity-related functions and FPSC III for others.

requirements.text: For pulse 3b, the ESA representative of this type shall be tested at +75 V (12 V system) or +150 V (24 V system) for 1 h, with FPSC I for immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity.
requirements.test_case: Apply pulse 3b at +75 V (12 V) or +150 V (24 V) for 1 h and verify FPSC I for immunity-related functions and FPSC III for others.

requirements.text: For starting profile, applicable to ESAs installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines started with a 12 V/24 V starter motor, the ESA representative of this type shall be tested at test level II with 10 pulses if it shall be operational during engine start phases, and otherwise classified C.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the vehicle powertrain and whether the lamp must operate during engine start; if so, run the starting profile at level II with 10 pulses, otherwise class C.

requirements.text: The Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied to the ESA representative of this type for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Check that the pulse test reports classify the lamp function per ISO 7637-1 FPSC.

requirements.text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Review the EMC test report for the ISO 16750-2 starting profile and ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b at the Table 3a/3b levels.

requirements.text: The starting profile of the ESA representative of this type shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
requirements.test_case: Check that the starting profile test report assesses results against the ISO 16750-1 functional status classes.

requirements.text: When the conformity of an ESA taken from the series is being verified for broadband and narrowband electromagnetic disturbances, the levels measured on the ESA shall not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 6.6.2.1. (and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1.).

When the conformity of an ESA taken from the series is being verified for immunity to electromagnetic radiation, the ESA shall not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle which could be observed by the driver or other road user when subjected to a field strength, expressed in Volts/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.8.2.1. (and, if applicable, paragraph 7.18.2.1.).
Frequency range and general test conditions shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the immunity test report for ISO 11452-1 conditions.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.test_case: Check in the test report that the lamp was in its normal operating mode.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be switched on.
requirements.test_case: Check in the test report that the lamp was energised during exposure.

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.
requirements.test_case: Check that the test report shows AM 1 kHz, 80% in 20-400 MHz.

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range.
requirements.test_case: Check that the test report shows PM2 (Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs) in 2,700-3,100 MHz.

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
requirements.test_case: Check that the test report shows PM3 (Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs) in 380-2,700 and 3,100-6,000 MHz.

requirements.text: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check that the immunity test report covers 20-6000 MHz.

requirements.text: The absorber chamber test of an ESA shall be performed with vertical polarization.
requirements.test_case: Check that the report states vertical polarization.

requirements.text: The test of the ESA shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench.
requirements.test_case: Review EMC test report for BCI immunity per ISO 11452-4.

requirements.text: The test method in Annex 10 shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply.
requirements.test_case: Run the ISO 7637-2 transient immunity test on each lamp and confirm there is no performance degradation.

requirements.text: The test method in Annex 10 shall limit conducted transients from ESAs to the vehicle power supply.
requirements.test_case: Measure transient conducted emissions per ISO 7637-2 and compare them with the limits.

requirements.text: For ESAs that are not exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor), the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Confirm from the product documentation whether the lamps are reserved exclusively for electric vehicles; if not, apply the ISO 16750-2 starting profile to the supply lines and check the lamp function.

requirements.text: The transient immunity test on 12/24 V supply lines shall apply test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Run the ISO 7637-2 transient immunity test with pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b on the supply lines and connected inputs of each lamp, and check the lamp function is not degraded.

requirements.text: The emission measurement of transient conducted disturbances generated by ESAs shall be made according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as on other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Measure transient emissions per ISO 7637-2 on the supply lines and the connections that may be connected to them, and check the results against the limits.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for a marking area of sufficient size.

requirements.text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visual check of legibility and a rub test with water and petrol.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for “a” shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure dimension a of the approval mark.

requirements.text: The four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2, shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Inspect that the sequential number sits close to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The arrow on the lamp shall be directed outwards from the vehicle for front or rear position lamps and front or rear end-outline marker lamps, on lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the lamp is handed (left/right specific) and, if so, that the arrow points outward.

requirements.text: The arrow on the lamp shall be directed outwards from the vehicle for reversing lamps in case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps, on lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately.
requirements.test_case: Check the light distribution type and handedness; verify the outward arrow if applicable.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.test_case: Inspect for the approval marking on each lamp.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect for the trade name or mark on the lamp.

requirements.text: In the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), the lamp shall bear a marking indicating also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Check the approval documents for LED substitute light sources and the corresponding marking.

requirements.text: Lamps, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, shall bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
requirements.test_case: Confirm whether the light sources are replaceable; if so check the category marking.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with an electronic light source control gear, a variable luminous intensity control, a secondary operating mode, or non-replaceable light sources.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the rated voltage or voltage range marking.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: If the modules are replaceable, check the voltage marking on the lamp.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii).
requirements.test_case: If the modules are replaceable, check that the lamp bears the module identification code.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: If the modules are replaceable, check the voltage marking on the module.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Confirm whether the modules are replaceable; if so check the applicant's mark on them.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the specific identification code of the light source module shall comprise the starting letters “MD” for “MODULE” followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1.
requirements.test_case: If the modules are replaceable, check for the MD code and approval mark.

requirements.text: In case several non-identical light source modules are used, the specific identification code of the light source module shall be followed by additional symbols or characters.
requirements.test_case: If non-identical modules are used, check the additional symbols in the identification code.

requirements.text: The approval mark on the light source module does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp in which the module is used, but both marks shall be from the same applicant.
requirements.test_case: If modules are used, compare the applicant on the module mark and the lamp mark.

requirements.text: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the control gear is outside the lamp body and, if so, its identification and manufacturer marking.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.test_case: Inspect that the approval marking is on a non-detachable inner or outer part.

requirements.text: In any case the approval marking and the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.test_case: Check visibility of the marking on the vehicle with the boot lid open.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking of the device shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the lens is detachable; if so check the marking on both lens and body.

requirements.text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval markings on the lens and that the body shows only its own functions.

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Inspect that the markings are on the lamp itself.

requirements.text: The markings in paragraph 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component.
requirements.test_case: If modules are replaceable, check that their markings are on the module component.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the approval mark is composed of several marks and measure the component sizes.

requirements.text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.test_case: Verify conformity with paragraphs 4 and 5 through type approval test report.

requirements.text: The requirements of sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp functions against the applicable R48 sections 5 and 6 requirements.

requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Review the requirements matrix for each lamp function for M1 against the test report.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Vibration test of the assembled lamp followed by a photometric and functional check.

requirements.text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, the functions shall either (a) be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source), or (b) be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check the design for multiple light sources or a tell-tale if the functions are incorporated.

requirements.text: Irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., the logo incorporated in a lamp shall be only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: If a logo is present, verify it is the vehicle or body manufacturer brand.

requirements.text: Notwithstanding the requirements of paragraph 5.5.2. of UN Regulation No. 48, the logo light emitting surface (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) shall not be required to be symmetrical by itself.
requirements.test_case: Check the logo design if present.

requirements.text: On request of the applicant, the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside the apparent surface of a lamp (function) shall be permitted to incorporate only one manufacturer logo built by transparent or non-transparent components, provided that all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation are fulfilled and the conditions (a) to (d) are met.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lens and optics for a logo and verify conditions (a) to (d) if present.

requirements.text: Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the stop and reversing lamp lens and optics for any logo.

requirements.text: The enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
requirements.test_case: Measure the logo light emitting area along the reference axis, which must be 100 cm2 or less.

requirements.text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light shall be considered to be one light source.

In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply: (a) the light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or (b) a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced, with a note in the communication form stating that the lamp is only for use on a vehicle fitted with a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.test_case: Check the number of light sources per lamp, then disable one source and measure that the minimum intensities are still met (and the maximum not exceeded) or that a failure tell-tale signal is produced.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2, rear end-outline marker lamp category RM2, stop lamp category S2 or S4, direction indicator of category 2b, or rear fog lamp of category F2, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Simulate a variable intensity control failure and verify steady intensity is met.

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Check the light source documentation for approved or non-replaceable LED modules.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
requirements.test_case: Check that any replaceable source can only be fitted in the correct position.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed applies, and, where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s) applies.
requirements.test_case: Check the holder against the IEC 60061 data sheet.

requirements.text: Light signalling devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: EMC test of radiated and conducted disturbances.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module shall not be interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source and/or with any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to interchange modules in the same housing.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.test_case: Check the module fitting and the tool-only removal.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the light source module shall be tamperproof.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the module for tamper-proofing.

requirements.text: When the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of device shall be met.
requirements.test_case: Replace the module with one bearing the same code and repeat the photometry.

requirements.text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all photometric and colorimetric measurements shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.

In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all photometric and colorimetric measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.

Where the lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions, the lamp shall meet the photometric requirements for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.
If not otherwise specified, the luminous intensities shall be met with the light source continuously lit.

In case measurement results are challenged, the intensity requirement for a particular direction of observation shall be deemed satisfied if met in a direction deviating by not more than one-quarter of a degree from the direction of observation.
Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.test_case: Check photometric tests are run at 6.75/13.5/28 V as per the vehicle system voltage.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Check the design for control gear and the applicant's specified operating conditions.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Verify the operating conditions specified by the applicant in the documents.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure maximum intensity in all visible directions against section 5 tables.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement on the reference axis against section 5 tables.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be either not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5 by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question, or not less than the intensity value as specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
requirements.test_case: Measure the light distribution grid against Annex 3 figures.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity within Annex 2 visibility angles.

requirements.text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Check local intensity variations per Annex 3.

requirements.text: Where the applicant requests the additional test to verify visibility of red light towards the front and/or white light towards the rear, the maximum intensity in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard horizontally and -2.5° to +5° vertically shall be not more than 2.5∙10-1 cd.

When an assembly of two independent lamps, to be type approved as lamps marked D and having the same function, is deemed to be a single lamp and all lamps together are lit, it shall comply with the maximum intensity requirements.
requirements.test_case: Check design documents for D-marked lamp assemblies.

requirements.text: When an assembly of two independent lamps, to be type approved as lamps marked D and having the same function, is deemed to be a single lamp and either lamp has failed, it shall comply with the minimum intensity requirements.
requirements.test_case: Check design documents; test with one lamp failed.

requirements.text: An interdependent lamp system shall meet the requirements when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
requirements.test_case: Check the application documents for interdependent lamp declarations; if present, verify photometry and colorimetry with all interdependent lamps operated together.

requirements.text: If the interdependent lamp system providing the rear position lamp is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, the inboard geometric visibility requirement is deemed to be satisfied if this (these) interdependent lamp(s) still conform to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device, at all fixed positions of the moveable component(s).
requirements.test_case: If split across a movable component, verify photometric values in the approval light-distribution field at all fixed positions of the movable component.

requirements.text: If the interdependent lamp system providing the rear position lamp is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the applicant shall meet the outboard geometric visibility colorimetric and photometric requirement, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
requirements.test_case: Check the mounting design for a movable component (e.g. tailgate); if split, measure outboard geometric visibility, colorimetry and photometry at all fixed positions.

requirements.text: Where a variable intensity control is used, it shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities outside the range specified in paragraph 5.

The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause the luminous intensity to exceed the respective steady luminous intensity maximum specified in paragraph 5. for the specific lamp, under night-time conditions, for systems depending only on daytime and night-time conditions.
requirements.test_case: Check for control; measure intensity at night conditions.

requirements.text: The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause the luminous intensity to exceed the respective steady luminous intensity maximum specified in paragraph 5. for the specific lamp, under standard conditions, for other systems.
requirements.test_case: Check for control; measure intensity under standard conditions.

requirements.text: If a rear position lamp and/or a rear end-outline marker lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously at the intensity of the rear position lamp or end-outline marker lamp when turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.
requirements.test_case: Check if the functions share a light source; measure the 5:1 ratio in the field.

requirements.text: The lamp shall meet the tests for compliance of the luminous intensities carried out according to Annex 8.

For lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
requirements.test_case: Colour measurement with the installed LED light sources.

requirements.text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3, no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Visual and colorimetric inspection outside the light distribution grid.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates within the Annex 3 grid field for each function.

requirements.text: For lamps (functions) using different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions in paragraphs 4.8.1. and 4.8.2.
requirements.test_case: Check light source technologies per function; test colour for each.

requirements.text: A luminous intensity of 6.0∙101 cd shall be permitted for rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp design documentation for reciprocal incorporation with the stop lamp, then measure intensity below the 5° downward plane against the 60 cd limit.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Photometric test of two samples against Table 4 luminous intensity values in the specified directions.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by rear position lamps (R1, R2, MR) and rear end-outline marker lamps (RM1, RM2) shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates of emitted light and check they fall within the red region.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of stop lamps supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Goniometric photometric measurement of two samples against Table 7 values.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by stop lamps shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of emitted light and check they lie within the red colour region.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10; however, in the case where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙101 cd shall be satisfied.
requirements.test_case: Goniometric photometric measurement of two samples against Table 10 intensity values (and 30° inward limit with 2.5∙10^1 cd if pair-only).

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by reversing lamps shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates of emitted light and verify they lie within the white colour boundaries.

requirements.text: For the minimum values required throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, the measured values shall correspond to the values shown in Table 12.
requirements.test_case: Goniometric photometry of production samples across the Annex 2 and 3 fields compared with Table 12 minimum values.

requirements.text: No measured value shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometric values of production samples and confirm no value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the prescribed values.

requirements.text: Position, end-outline marker, stop, front and rear direction indicators, daytime running and front and rear parking lamps shall have the minimum horizontal and vertical angles of geometric visibility given in Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure the horizontal and vertical angles of geometric visibility of the rear position and stop lamps against Table A2-1 on a goniometer or by drawing check.

requirements.text: Front and rear position lamps, when intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, shall have the photometric intensity verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the manufacturer's declared H plane mounting height; if it is 750 mm or less, verify photometry only up to 5° downwards.

requirements.text: Stop lamps of category S1, S2 and MS, when intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, shall have the photometric intensity verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the stop lamp category and declared mounting height; if it is S1/S2/MS and 750 mm or less, verify photometry only up to 5° downwards.

requirements.text: Unless specified otherwise, the minimum intensity percentages given by the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
requirements.test_case: Check that the photometric minimum values derived from Figures A3-I to A3-XV are rounded down to three significant digits.

requirements.text: The light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines of the light distribution shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of intensity at the grid directions against the minimum percentages.

requirements.text: In the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of a lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement referred to above is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
requirements.test_case: Visually examine the lamp, and if local variations appear, confirm that intensity between measurement directions is at least 50% of the lower prescribed minimum.

requirements.text: The values shown in Figure A3-I shall give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8) for front and rear position lamps, parking lamps, front and rear end-outline marker lamps, stop lamps (S1, S2 and MS) and direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity at the Figure A3-I directions and compare with the percentage of the Table 3/7 minimum.

requirements.text: The values shown in figure A3-V shall give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities in cd for reversing lamps.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of the reversing lamp against the Figure A3-V minimum cd values.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure luminous intensity at 1 min and 10 min of operation and compare to the min/max limits.

requirements.text: For all other lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation, or after photometric stability has occurred, shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity at 1 min and at 30 min or stability and compare to the min/max limits.

requirements.text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of each lamp (function) shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the photometric distribution at the Table A8-1 time for LED lamps.

requirements.text: Where a lamp function uses a light generating technology other than incandescent or LED, its intensity requirements shall be met from the point in time listed in Table A8-1 until photometric stability is reached.

Where a lamp function uses more than one light generating technology, its intensity requirements shall be met following the strictest time requirements of paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.3. for the combination.

In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested and checked for compliance at all points in time starting at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
requirements.test_case: Review the run-up behaviour; if unexpected, test minimum intensity at all points in time until stability.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2., or for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the device for a sufficiently sized space for approval marking and other markings.

requirements.text: All markings on the retro-reflector shall be clearly legible and indelible.
The approval marking shall consist of a four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Check that the approval marking has a four to six-digit sequential number matching the approval number.

requirements.text: The sequential number of the approval marking shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Inspect that the sequential number is placed close to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown in Figure I.
requirements.test_case: If a UI is marked, compare it with the format in Figure I.

requirements.text: The approval marking as defined in paragraph 3.3.2. shall be permitted to be replaced by the Unique Identifier, if available.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval documents for whether a Unique Identifier is used in place of the approval marking.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the device for the applicant's trade name or mark.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall bear, in case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the word “TOP” inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check the class and the manufacturer's rotation angles; if required, verify that TOP is inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface.

requirements.text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraph 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect that the markings are legible on the device.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is used for the lamp under several UN Regulations, the size of the components of the single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.

In conformity of production checks, the mean value of the photometric measurements of five retro-reflector specimens taken at random shall not deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the prescribed values given in paragraphs 4. and 5.

The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Review the applicable requirements list against the device and M1 installation.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Durability and ageing tests plus visual inspection after the test series.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.
requirements.test_case: Visual and dimensional inspection of samples for defects.

requirements.text: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the design and attempt manual dismantling without tools.

requirements.text: Any protuberances that retro-reflective devices may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of protuberances and a cleaning check.

requirements.text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean and shall therefore not be rough.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the outer surface and check its roughness.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device shall provide no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the assembly for access to the inner optical surface when installed.

requirements.text: Retro-reflectors shall be permitted to consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter.
requirements.test_case: Check the design documents for a combined unit and filter.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflector consists of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, the unit and filter shall be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
requirements.test_case: If combined, attempt separation under normal use conditions and inspect the design.

requirements.text: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish shall not be permitted.
requirements.test_case: Document and visual check that the colour comes from the material and not from a coating.

requirements.text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric test under Illuminant A at 1/3° divergence and β1=β2=0°.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure the trichromatic coordinates and compare them to the R48 colour boundaries.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7. and depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices, shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7.
requirements.test_case: Run the 5.1.7 physical and mechanical test sequence and review the results.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval class marking and verify dimensions and shape against Annex 5.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Photometric and colorimetric test per 5.1.4 and 5.1.5 on samples.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector samples shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and, at least one hour after this test, shall meet the colorimetric characteristics of paragraph 5.1.5. and the RI of paragraph 5.1.4. for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° (or, if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.).

The retro-reflector shall pass the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) followed by the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7), the corrosion test (Part 4 of Annex 6, if necessary) followed by the abrasive-strength test of the rear face (Part 5 of Annex 6), the test for stability in time of the optical properties (Part 3 of Annex 4) and the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Measure trichromatic coordinates after the 5.1.3.1 tests against 5.1.5.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI after the 5.1.3.1 tests against the 5.1.4 limits.

requirements.text: Where more than one or a range of axes of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the retro-reflector shall meet the photometric requirements with reference to each axis of reference or to the extreme axes of reference of the specified range.

The illuminating surface of the Class IA or IB retro-reflector considered for photometric measurements, defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system as indicated by the manufacturer, shall be contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter.

The illuminating surface of the Class IA or IB retro-reflector considered for photometric measurements shall be limited to 100 cm2, and the manufacturer shall specify the perimeter of the area to be used.

When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for amber retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB shall be equal to or greater than the Table 3 values of 7.50∙10^2, 5.00∙10^2 and 2.50∙10^2 mcd·lx-1 at 20' and 1.25∙10^1, 7∙10^0 and 6.25∙10^0 mcd·lx-1 at 1°30' for the illumination angles shown.
requirements.test_case: Determine the colour, then measure RI against the Table 3 amber values.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB shall be equal to or greater than the Table 3 values of 3.00∙10^2, 2.00∙10^2 and 1.00∙10^2 mcd·lx-1 at 20' and 5∙10^0, 2.8∙10^0 and 2.5∙10^0 mcd·lx-1 at 1°30' for the illumination angles shown.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI per Annex 4 and compare with the Table 3 red values.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux, for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI per Annex 4 Part 1 and compare with Table 3 red values.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for white retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB shall be equal to or greater than the Table 3 values of 1.20∙10^3, 8.00∙10^2 and 4.00∙10^2 mcd·lx-1 at 20' and 2.0∙10^1, 1.12∙10^1 and 1.0∙10^1 mcd·lx-1 at 1°30' for the illumination angles shown.
requirements.test_case: Determine the colour, then measure RI against the Table 3 white values.

requirements.text: RI values lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 shall not be permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the lines (beta1 = ±10°, beta2 = 0°) and (beta1 = ±5°, beta2 = ±20°).
requirements.test_case: Measure RI within the specified solid angle and compare with the last two Table 3 columns.

requirements.text: For a retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the mounting height and, if below 750 mm, limit RI verification to 5° downwards.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux of the retro-reflector device shall be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure trichromatic coordinates and compare with the UN R48 limits for the colour.

requirements.text: The Class IA or IB retro-reflector samples shall pass the tests in the chronological order of Table 4, including visual inspection, colorimetry and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0° after each test sequence.

The retro-reflector shall withstand the heat test of Part 1 of Annex 6 for 48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C, followed by visual inspection for distortion, colorimetry and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.

The retro-reflector shall withstand the water test for 10 min in normal position and 10 min in inverted position, followed by visual inspection, colorimetry and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
The retro-reflector shall withstand the motor fuels test of Part 1 of Annex 7 for 5 min, followed by visual inspection.
The retro-reflector shall withstand the oils test of Part 2 of Annex 7 for 5 min, followed by visual inspection, colorimetry and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
The retro-reflector shall withstand the corrosion test of Part 4 of Annex 6 (24 hours, 2 hours interval, 24 hours), followed by visual inspection.
The rear face of the retro-reflector shall withstand the rear face test for 1 min, followed by visual inspection, colorimetry and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
The retro-reflector shall pass the stability in time test of Part 3 of Annex 4, followed by colorimetry (visual inspection or trichromatic coordinates) and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.

The retro-reflector shall pass the resistance to weathering test of Part 6 of Annex 6, followed by colorimetry (visual inspection or trichromatic coordinates) and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.

The shape of the illuminating surfaces of retro-reflective devices of Class IA or IB shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the retro-reflector class, then check the illuminating-surface shape against drawings and by visual inspection from 10 m to confirm it is not easily confused with a triangle.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 ºC.
requirements.test_case: Hold the sample 48 h dry at 65±2 °C, cool 1 h at 23±2 °C, then inspect.

requirements.text: After this heat test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component shall be visible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the reflector and its prism optics for cracks or distortion after the heat test.

requirements.text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the retro-reflective device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect after the immersion test; any clearly visible water means the test is failed.

requirements.text: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.
requirements.test_case: After the water immersion test, visually inspect the reflecting surface of the retro-reflector for water ingress.

requirements.text: In the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
requirements.test_case: Shake off excess water, then measure RI by the 5.1.3.2.2 method and compare with the requirement.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.
requirements.test_case: Perform the salt mist test and re-measure photometry and colorimetry afterwards against the prescribed values.

requirements.text: The resistance of the front surface to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration of retro-reflective devices shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.
requirements.test_case: Review the BOM and construction for essential metal components; if present, inspect front surface tarnishing and rear face protection after the test.

requirements.text: The resistance-to-corrosion test of retro-reflective devices shall be conducted as described in ISO Standard 9227:2017.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report states the corrosion test was conducted per ISO 9227:2017 (neutral salt spray).

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.test_case: Expose the sample to saline mist for 2 x 24 h with a 2 h drying interval and record the durations in the report.

requirements.text: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.test_case: Confirm whether essential metal components exist; if so, verify chamber temperature of 35 ± 2 °C during the test.

requirements.text: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline solution used to produce the saline mist shall be obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
requirements.test_case: Confirm whether essential metal components exist; if so, check the solution is 5 parts NaCl in 95 parts distilled water with at most 0.02 % impurities.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample of the retro-reflective device shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the sample immediately after the salt mist test for corrosion that impairs efficiency.

requirements.text: In case of retro-reflective devices, the samples shall be exposed for a period of 500 hours.
requirements.test_case: Verify the weathering test report shows 500 h exposure of retro-reflector samples.

requirements.text: The samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1.
requirements.test_case: Expose retro-reflector samples per EN ISO 4892-2 with Table A6-1 parameters and check post-exposure photometric/colour requirements.

requirements.text: A test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied for either a retro-reflective device or a sample unit of retro-reflective marking material, as set out in paragraphs 1.1 and 1.2 of Annex 7 Part 1.
requirements.test_case: Check the fuel resistance test report uses 70% n-heptane / 30% toluol.

requirements.text: After about five minutes, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device shall not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.test_case: Wipe the PMMA reflector with the mixture, wait about 5 min, then inspect the surface visually.

requirements.text: After the surface has been cleaned, the RI of the retro-reflective device shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Expose a sample to detergent lubricating oil, clean it, measure RI per 5.1.3.2.2 and compare against the required minimum values.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, it is not possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the fixing method (clips and fasteners) and check by a vibration or handling test that the device position does not shift.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation against the UN R48 position, visibility and geometry requirements for each device, and check the approval documents.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the installation and mounting design, and run a vibration test followed by photometric or colorimetric re-verification of each device.

requirements.text: The reference axis of all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3° allowed in each direction.
requirements.test_case: Measure reference axis angle to the bearing plane on the vehicle (±3°).

requirements.text: The reference axis of all other light-signalling devices when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3° allowed in each direction.
requirements.test_case: Measure reference axis against the median longitudinal plane (±3°).

requirements.text: Where the manufacturer lays down specific instructions as regards fitting, the reference axis of each light-signalling device when fitted to the vehicle shall comply with those instructions.
requirements.test_case: Check fitting instructions and verify axis complies.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.
requirements.test_case: Measure height and orientation with vehicle unladen on a flat horizontal surface.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.
requirements.test_case: Measure positions of paired lamps relative to the median longitudinal plane.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this requirement not being valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Visual and dimensional comparison of left and right lamps.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of both lamps of a pair.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics; this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.test_case: Photometric comparison of both lamps of a pair.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, all logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos shall be prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Inspect any logos to confirm they are vehicle or body manufacturer logos only.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo shall be fitted on the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect for logos and count their number and position on the rear.

requirements.text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the requirements of paragraph 5.5 shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
requirements.test_case: Check vehicle body shape and the symmetry of the installation.

requirements.text: Lamps shall be permitted to be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Verify colour, position, orientation, visibility and wiring of each function in the combined unit.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Photometric test of each function with the other functions switched OFF.

requirements.text: When a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other functions which can be switched ON together with them, the colour requirements of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Check the design for reciprocal incorporation and measure colour with the functions ON together.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), whose apparent surface is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent or tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, except that these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Project the apparent surface and check the 60% area or 75 mm distance criterion.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that either the projection of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of the two lamps or retro reflectors occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projections of the said apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of two lamps or two independent retro reflectors does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Check the configuration and, if two units, the 60% or 75 mm criterion.

requirements.text: A lamp in the shape of a band or strip shall be permitted to be part of an interdependent lamp system.
requirements.test_case: Check lamp shape against the drawings.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Check approval markings for 'Y' and the apparent surface criterion.
