requirements.text: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens, these shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system.
requirements.test_case: Design review of the shared lamp body and lens.

requirements.text: The illumination of a band or strip lamp surface shall be provided by not less than two light sources placed as close as possible to the ends.
requirements.test_case: If strip lamps, check at least two light sources near the ends.

requirements.text: The light-emitting surface of a band or strip lamp shall be permitted to be constituted by a number of juxtaposed elements on condition that these individual light-emitting surfaces, when projected on a transverse plane, fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
requirements.test_case: If juxtaposed elements, check the projection against paragraph 5.7.2.1.

requirements.text: Two lamps or an even number of lamps in the shape of a band or strip shall be placed symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, extending on both sides to within at least 0.4 m of the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: If strip lamps, measure symmetry and the distance to the outer edge (≤0.4 m).

requirements.text: Two lamps or an even number of lamps in the shape of a band or strip shall have a length of not less than 0.8 m.
requirements.test_case: If strip lamps, measure length (≥0.8 m).

requirements.text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation and check that no red light is visible from the front.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity while ON and check it is constant, with no modulation circuit.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp shall be permitted to vary as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, provided that any variation is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Verify photometry with other lamps switched ON/OFF stays within the provisions.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp shall be permitted to vary in relation to the ambient light, provided that any variation is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: If variation exists, verify it stays within the lamp's technical provisions.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp shall be permitted to vary when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, provided that any variation is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Check whether any lamp provides an additional function and verify photometry for each function.

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Check visibility of the red apparent surface from Zone 1 at 25 m per Annex 4.

requirements.text: In case of doubt, the no-direct-visibility requirement of paragraphs 5.10.4.1. and 5.10.4.2. shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.test_case: Measure luminous intensity towards the front and confirm it is no more than 0.25 cd per lamp.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Check the wiring and switching: all listed position lamps turn ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval markings for Y interdependence and verify simultaneous switching.

requirements.text: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation to confirm the lamps and reflector cannot be concealed.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.test_case: Measure the emitted colour chromaticity against the red limits.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.test_case: Check the emitted colour is white by colorimetric measurement or the approval documents.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.test_case: Measure the emitted colour chromaticity against the red limits.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall emit red light.
requirements.test_case: Check the reflector colour by colorimetric measurement or the approval marking.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, triangular, shall emit red light.
requirements.test_case: Check the reflector shape in the drawings and its colour.

requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Count the installed lamps and reflectors against the numbers in the individual specifications.

requirements.text: Any lamp shall be permitted to be installed on movable components, provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18, 5.19 and 5.20 are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the lamps are on movable parts such as a tailgate; if so, verify 5.18-5.20.

requirements.text: At all fixed positions of the movable components, the rear position lamps, rear direction-indicators and rear retro-reflectors on the movable components shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
requirements.test_case: Measure position, geometric visibility and photometry at all fixed positions of the movable component.

requirements.text: In the case where the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D" (see paragraph 2.4.11.1.), only one of the lamps shall meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components.
requirements.test_case: Check the markings and the mounting.

requirements.text: Where additional lamps for the functions of paragraph 5.18. are fitted and are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, these additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Check for additional lamps and verify their requirements.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector function is obtained by an interdependent lamp system on movable components, either (a) when the complete system is on the moving component(s), paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied (additional lamps switched ON in open positions meeting all position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements), or (b) when partly on fixed and partly on movable components, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant shall meet all position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component(s), inwards visibility being deemed satisfied if the photometric values in the field of light distribution are still met.
When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.test_case: With the movable part open, check that there is no undue discomfort to other road users.

requirements.text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check that the lamp returns to the specified position after moving the component.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.test_case: Check that no more than 50% of the apparent surface is hidden in any fixed position.

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21. is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Check for additional lamps that switch on when the apparent surface is hidden.

requirements.text: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the light source is replaceable and, if so, replace it without special tools.

requirements.text: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement of light sources of lamps approved according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle documentation for a replacement procedure.

requirements.text: Where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, this light source shall be replaceable as required in paragraph 5.23.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the module for a replaceable light source holder.

requirements.text: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp shall be permitted, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.
requirements.test_case: Simulate a failure and check the replacement function's colour, intensity and position.

requirements.text: During replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.test_case: Simulate a failure and check that the dashboard tell-tale indicates it.

requirements.text: In the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
requirements.test_case: Measure the intensity ratio between the lamps across the transitions.

requirements.text: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., shall be permitted.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp category and whether it has variable intensity control.

requirements.text: The intensity of all the lamps mentioned in paragraph 5.26., when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, shall vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Measure the intensities of the combined lamps across the control range.

requirements.text: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b and rear position lamps shall be permitted to increase or decrease the luminous intensity, within the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, in relation to the following conditions: ambient lighting, fog, snowfall, rain, spray, dust clouds, and contamination of the light emitting surface.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp design and control documents for variable-intensity operation and verify intensity stays within the limits of the pertinent UN Regulation.

requirements.text: Independently from the environmental conditions in paragraph 5.26.1, rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b and rear position lamps shall be permitted to decrease the luminous intensity, within the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m.
requirements.test_case: Check the control strategy documents and measure the intensity at speed of 20 km/h or less to confirm it stays within the permitted limits.

requirements.text: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b and rear position lamps shall be permitted to keep an intensity decrease already activated active as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h.
requirements.test_case: Check the control logic and run a vehicle speed test to confirm the decrease is kept only up to 50 km/h.

requirements.text: Lamps with variable luminous intensity under paragraphs 5.26.1 to 5.26.3 shall show no sharp variation of intensity during transition.
requirements.test_case: Record the intensity during transitions and check that there are no sharp steps.

requirements.text: The variable luminous intensity functions described in paragraphs 5.26.1 to 5.26.3 shall be permitted to be set by the driver to static luminous intensities.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle function description for driver selection of static intensity.

requirements.text: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval documents for a special supply and compare the terminal voltage with the approved voltage.

requirements.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1, the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.test_case: Measure the voltage at the lamp terminals with the vehicle electrical system running and check it does not exceed the limit.

requirements.text: The means of controlling the maximum voltage at the terminals of the device shall be permitted to be located within the body of the device, for convenience.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the design to see where voltage control is located and check the terminal voltage.

requirements.text: The lamp shall have no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity; however, no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamps and check that nothing obstructs the geometric visibility angles.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, the applicant shall furnish proof that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Check the installed vehicle for hidden surface areas and, if any, verify photometry of the visible part.

requirements.text: When the lamp is at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1., the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit shall be permitted to be reduced to 5º below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height above the ground and check the photometric field used.

requirements.text: When the lamp is at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1., the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal shall be permitted to be reduced to 5º.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height above the ground and apply the matching visibility angle.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval documents for interdependent (Y-marked) lamps and test visibility with all operated together.

requirements.text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval marks and certificates of each device against its device Regulation.

requirements.text: A light-signalling lamp incorporating a manufacturer logo shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for a logo and, if present, check approval under UN R148.

requirements.text: One reversing lamp device shall be fitted on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.
requirements.test_case: Count reversing lamp devices on the vehicle; confirm one.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check for UN R23 or R148 approval marking and certificate.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in height not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground; for category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure height of the lamp's illuminating surface above ground in the laden/unladen condition.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed position to confirm it is at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: Reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle shall have a geometric visibility defined by angle α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.
requirements.test_case: Check visibility angles per 2.10.7 on the installed vehicle.

requirements.text: Reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle shall have a geometric visibility defined by angle β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, and 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.
requirements.test_case: Check horizontal visibility of 45° left and right per 2.10.7.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test: switch ON only with reverse engaged and ignition on.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Disengage reverse or switch off propulsion and verify the lamp turns off.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure shall be mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the component regulation for a tell-tale requirement and, if required, verify the tell-tale on the vehicle.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp's approval marking and certificate against UN R7 02+ or UN R148 00+.

requirements.text: On M1 and N1 category vehicles, the S1 or S2 category stop lamp device whose apparent surface points in the direction of the reference axis farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall be not more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance from the apparent surface's outermost point to the vehicle's outer edge on the vehicle.

requirements.text: If the optional S1 or S2 category stop lamps are installed, they shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check on the vehicle whether optional lamps are fitted and their height compatibility with the width and symmetry requirements.

requirements.text: If the optional S1 or S2 category stop lamps are installed, they shall be positioned at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
requirements.test_case: If optional lamps are fitted, measure the vertical distance, which must be at least 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be positioned above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the lamp's apparent surface above ground at the vehicle's design ride height.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall be positioned such that the horizontal plane tangential to the upper edge of its apparent surface is below the horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the apparent surface of the S3 or S4 category device.
S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect that the stop lamp is mounted at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For S1 and S2 category stop lamps mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° shall be permitted to be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height of the lamp's reference point per 5.8.1 and verify the inward angle accordingly.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 category stop lamps shall provide geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Verify the vertical visibility angles of 15° up and down using the installation drawings and a visibility check.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 category stop lamps shall provide geometric visibility of 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check the goniometric visibility angles of 45° left and right of the longitudinal axis against the installation drawings and photometric test.

requirements.text: Where an optional S1 or S2 stop lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the upward angle of 15° shall be permitted to be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check the mounting height and whether the lamp is optional, then verify the upward angle.

requirements.text: Where the S1 or S2 stop lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° shall be permitted to be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height per 5.8.1 and check the downward visibility angle.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Actuate the service brake and verify all stop lamps light simultaneously.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the stop lamps shall be provided if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the component regulation (UN R7/R148) for a tell-tale requirement, then check the vehicle for one.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval marking and certificate against UN R7 (02 or later) or UN R148 (00 or later).

requirements.text: The rear position lamp point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; this condition shall not apply to the optional rear lamps.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance from the outermost point of the apparent surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge (max 400 mm).

requirements.text: The rear position lamp height above the ground shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm, or 2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and the optional lamps are not installed.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height above the ground of the lowest and highest points of the apparent surface on the vehicle at its unladen condition.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle to verify the lamp is mounted at the rear.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall provide geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Check vertical geometric visibility of ±15° on the installed lamp.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall provide geometric visibility of 45° inwards and 80° outwards in the horizontal angle.
requirements.test_case: Check the installed lamp's horizontal visibility angles (45° inwards, 80° outwards) by geometric measurement on the vehicle.

requirements.text: Where an optional rear position lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the upward angle of 15° shall be permitted to be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check the mounting height per 5.8.1 and whether the lamp is optional; if above 2,100 mm, verify the upward angle is at least 5°.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° shall be permitted to be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height per 5.8.1 and, if below 750 mm, verify the downward angle is at least 5°.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° shall be permitted to be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height per 5.8.1 and, if below 750 mm, verify the inward angle is at least 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: The illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded from the unobstructed view area of the rear position lamp.
requirements.test_case: Check that the retro-reflector's non-light-transmitting area is excluded from the measured unobstructed area of the position lamp.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp of an M1 or N1 category vehicle shall provide geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check for a rear side-marker lamp and the chosen alternative; if applicable, verify ±15° vertical visibility.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp of an M1 or N1 category vehicle shall provide geometric visibility of 45° outwards to 45° inwards in the horizontal angle, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the vehicle has a rear side-marker lamp and whether the alternative is chosen; if so, verify ±45° horizontal visibility.

requirements.text: To be considered visible, the rear position lamp of an M1 or N1 category vehicle shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres.
requirements.test_case: If the alternative is used, measure the unobstructed apparent surface and verify it is at least 12.5 cm².

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp of an M1 or N1 category vehicle is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° shall be permitted to be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify mounting height and side-marker presence; if applicable, check the downward angle is at least 5°.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp of an M1 or N1 category vehicle is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° shall be permitted to be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Verify mounting height and side-marker presence; if applicable, check the inward angle is at least 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: If a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator, the electrical connection of the rear position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it shall be permitted to be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction indicator; if so, verify the position lamp switches off during indicator operation.

requirements.text: The electrical connection of the rear position lamp shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the wiring and verify the electrical connection complies with paragraph 5.11.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall have a closed-circuit tell-tale that is combined with that of the front position lamps, except while daytime running lamps are switched ON.
Where required by the component Regulation, a tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamps shall be provided.

Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4. below) shall be permitted, provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection that any additional reflecting devices do not reduce the effectiveness of the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflectors shall be two in number, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Check the type-approval marking and certificate for Class IA/IB under UN R3 (02 series or later) or UN R150 (00 series or later); confirm two units are fitted.

requirements.text: That point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance from the outermost point of the illuminating surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge; must be at most 400 mm.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be positioned above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively).
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the lowest and highest points of the illuminating surface above ground in the unladen condition; 250 mm to 900 mm, or up to 1,200 mm if grouped with a rear lamp.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation drawing or vehicle to confirm the reflector is at the rear.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall have a horizontal angle of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.test_case: Check by drawing or measurement that the visibility is unobstructed within 30° inwards and outwards.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall have a vertical angle of 10° above and below horizontal; however, where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check by drawing or measurement that the visibility is unobstructed within 10° up and down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm).
